fields.v: Not stated in Böckeler's terms; specification precedes implementation and substantive defects are fixed by revising the specification and regenerating the whole code in a fresh context, never by patching ('regeneration over incremental patching'), a spec-as-source trait; only minor UI issues are adjusted by targeted prompts and spec maintenance after release is not described. Closest to spec-as-source within the authoring cycle, otherwise spec-first (classification by the drafter)
fields.quote: Substantive defects trigger full regeneration from a revised specification on a clean context buffer rather than iterative patching.
fields.where: Fig. 1 caption and §II.A phase 8 Acceptance gate, p. 2
fields.why: The workflow fixes substantive errors only by editing the specification and regenerating the code, which matches Böckeler's spec-as-source more than spec-first, so the level is a judgement call.
fields.doubt: O artigo corrige erros sérios só revendo a especificação e gerando o código de novo, sem remendar o código (Fig. 1, pág. 2). Isso parece spec-as-source; só ajustes pequenos de interface são feitos por prompts. Decide entre spec-first e spec-as-source.
